data.title: Bitcoin's MVRV drops below 30th percentile after $87K rejection
data.description: Bitcoin keeps knocking on the door at $87,000. The door keeps not opening.After repeated rejections near that level, a key on-chain valuation gauge has slipped below its 30th percentile.
